name: 張庭瑜
objective:
本課程主要目的在於讓學生透過熟悉財金時事所使用之英文專業名詞、市場術語，以及行業慣有之英文論述結構等提升財金領域之專業英文閱讀能力；此外，本課程亦將著重於訓練學生之英譯能力。
The major purpose of this course is to promote learners’ reading ability by training them to understand terminologies, jargons and description structure of writings in finance news and events. In addition, this course also aims to train the learners’ ability of translating English into Chinese.
課程進度(1-16週):
Week 1: Course Introduction - Overview of course, grading, report format, and how to track reliable financial news
Week 2: Tech & Finance Basics - Role of tech stocks in global markets; why they drive sentiment
Week 3: Semiconductors & Supply Chains - Chip war, geopolitics, supply chain restructuring
Week 4: AI & Market Impact - Generative AI boom, capital flows, productivity & risk
Week 5: Tech IPOs - Startup listings (IPO, SPAC), valuation, fundraising trends
Week 6: Big Tech Earnings - Apple, Meta, Amazon, NVIDIA earnings and market reactions
Week 7: Digital Finance & FinTech - Virtual banks, payment innovations, digital transformation in finance
Week 8: Blockchain & Crypto - Bitcoin, Ethereum, USDT, regulatory environment
Week 9: ESG & Green Tech - EVs, renewable energy, carbon markets and sustainability
Week 10: Tech & Consumer Markets - E-commerce, platform economy, advertising ecosystems
Week 11: Tech War & Geopolitics - US–China tech rivalry, export controls, policy risk
Week 12: Tech Investment Trends - Cross-border deals, M & A, venture capital in tech
Week 13: Macroeconomics & Tech Valuations - Interest rates, inflation (CPI), Fed policies, and their impact on tech growth
Week 14: Cybersecurity & Data Regulation - Cyber threats, data privacy, antitrust, and compliance costs
Week 15: Comprehensive Case Study - The "Magnificent Seven", the AI capital loop (Infinite Money Glitch), and bubble risks
Week 16: Course Wrap-up & Future Outlook - Semester review and forecasting future intersections of tech and finance

scorePolicy:
1. Participation & Discussion: 20%
Attendance and active participation in class
Contribution to group discussions and Q&A
Engagement during peer presentations
2. Weekly News Analysis (In-class Presentation): 60%
Every two weeks, the group presents a report on a selected news article ( ~15 minutes ).
Evaluation criteria: completeness of summary, data & background analysis, discussion of impacts, clarity of delivery
Grading is group-based, but individual contribution will also be observed
3. Personal Report: 20%
Each student submits a Final written report
Required sections: news source, summary, background, supporting data, impact analysis, personal opinion
Evaluation criteria: completeness (40%), depth of analysis (30%), originality of insights (20%), formatting & punctuality (10%)
materials:
核心必讀 (Essential - 費與易取得的資源)：
Reuters (路透社)： 提供快速、簡明且可靠的全球市場、政治與商業新聞
Bloomberg (彭博社)： 追蹤每日市場、經濟與科技報導（可閱讀費文章）
Yahoo Finance： 結合股市數據與財經新聞的整合平台
Financial Times (金融時報)： 具備強大的全球金融焦點

進階推薦 (Recommended - 建議訂閱或透過圖書館取得)：
The Wall Street Journal (華爾街日報)： 深入分析美國與國際商業市場
The Economist (經濟學人)： 探討政策、背景與全球宏觀趨勢
CNBC： 追蹤美國市場與企業的即時新聞

產業導向與進階資料 (Advanced / Industry-Oriented)：
TechCrunch： 聚焦科技、新創公司與創新技術
Forbes / Fortune： 商業、領導力與市場趨勢
Company Investor Relations (IR) pages (企業投資人關係專頁)： 用於取得官方財報、新聞稿與法說會資料

remarks:
彈性學習 / Flexible Learning 教師需於「課程進度」填寫 1 至 16 週課程內容，並於下列欄位填寫 17 至 18 週彈性學習內容。
一、類別 (可複選)
參與課程相關作業、作品、實驗、田野調查
二、內容 
(1) 第 17 週: 本週為彈性學習，學生需彙整本學期所學之「科技與金融」核心概念，選定一則特定的重大財金時事（如科技巨頭財報、地緣政治等），獨立進行資料蒐集與分析。 
(2) 第 18 週: 學生完成撰寫並繳交 1-2 頁之期末個人書面報告 (Personal Report)，由教師進行評閱與提供個別回饋。
三、時數 總共 6 小時。
四、學習成果 第 18 週規定時間內繳交期末個人書面報告，以此檢視學生對新聞事件背景的掌握完整度、分析深度與見解原創性。
五、評量比例 (1) 期末個人書面報告 (Personal Report):20%
